continuation-H3b-s4_unsafe.mechanism: Unsafe report stop-before-marker variant; not the original no-op-marker seed
continuation-H3b-s4_unsafe.note: Typed rc-file 102 is accepted during START. stop_run initiates cleanup; its background worker kills/pops an unbootstrapped SJ before its waiter captures the record. After tracking is inserted and the outcome deadline expires, COMPLETED is latched/published while the report handler is still at Mark. This is an unsafe-triggered stop/marker plus lost-waiter-record variant, not proof that mark_run_aborted executed as a no-op before insertion (RS-5). Source JR:798-811, FS:952-957, SE:203-234/385-409. Actual preserved-102 path and relative timer/handler schedule remain mandatory; bare OS102 is insufficient.
